title: Cockroach Janta Party plans Delhi protest demanding CEC resignation
seoTitle: Delhi protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar

tea.why: Protesters allege misconduct by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and question his appointment.
tea.want: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 7: Delhi Police denied permission for the protest, but organizers stated they only provided intimation, not sought permission.

summary: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced a protest for October 10, 2026, at Jantar Mantar in Delhi, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. CJP co-convenor Saurav Das submitted an 'intimation letter' to Delhi Police on October 7, stating the demonstration would be a youth-led event with participants from across the country. While police acknowledged the intimation, The Times of India reported that permission for the protest was denied. Delhi Police are implementing security measures, including monitoring bus movements and engaging with educational institutions to discourage student participation.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: Delhi Police acknowledged an intimation letter from the organizers and took an undertaking, according to The Hindu. However, The Times of India reported that police denied permission for the protest. updates.text: Cockroach Janta Party co-convenor Saurav Das submitted an intimation letter to Delhi Police regarding the planned October 10 protest.
Delhi Police acknowledged the intimation but denied permission for the proposed demonstration, according to The Times of India.
Police began implementing security measures, including monitoring bus movements and advising educational institutions to discourage student participation.
